newsitem.title: USA: Union says UPS strike action postponed.
newsitem.headline: Union says UPS strike action postponed.

text.p: The Teamsters Union said in a statement early Friday that strike action against United Parcel Service had been postponed until further notice and no time limit had been set on the contract talks under way in Washington.

The two sides had agreed to continue negotiations past a midnight deadline Thursday for a strike that could cripple the large parcel carrier. The union did not say whether any progress had yet been made in the talks, which began around 7 p.m. EDT.
"Negotiators for the Teamsters Union and United Parcel Service are continuing to negotiate at this hour," the union statement said. "No agreement on a new contract has been reached.
"Strike action has been postponed until further notice. At this time, no time limit has been set on how long the negotiators will continue tonight," it continued.
UPS spokeswoman Gina Ellrich echoed the union statement saying, "Our negotiators have confirmed that any job action has been postponed, there is no time limit and talks are continuing."
